summary: Spire Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a definitive agreement for its subsidiary Spire EnergySouth Inc. to sell all shares of Spire Mississippi Inc. to Delta Mississippi Gas Company, LLC for $75 million, subject to purchase price adjustments. The target operates a natural gas utility in Mississippi. Closing is expected in Spire's fiscal Q1 2027, pending MPSC regulatory approval and customary conditions. A reverse termination fee of $7.5 million (10% of purchase price) applies for the purchaser on certain terminations, including a burdensome condition. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for MPSC approval timeline and any conditions that could trigger the reverse termination fee or delay the close.
